Image Voice Translator

Pick up to three reference colours, correct your photos to them, then translate each photo into sound with a voice sample. Colour sets the available pitches, the outline draws the melody, and the texture becomes a grain cloud. Each photo gives two versions: pitches from the voice's own harmonics, and pitches from the 12-note scale.

      Each reference colour is matched to the pixels in each photo that lie within the match distance of it (CIELAB ΔE). A reference with too few close pixels is skipped for that photo. The matched pairs set one white-balance correction for the whole photo; channels the reference colours barely contain change little. Photos are resized to 600 px wide.
